title: Parade bands, Joe Oliver and Louis Armstrong, and the shortage of players
summary: He played with Oliver and Armstrong in parade bands; bands were always short of men, so almost anyone who could play got work and swapped between bands.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline
